description: Check whether a promo code applies to a basket of slimes (by slug and quantity) and estimate the saving. A rejected code returns valid=false with the shop's standard message; checkout always re-checks codes.

code.description: Promo code exactly as the shopper has it, e.g. 'WELCOME10'

items.description: The slimes the code would apply to; codes can depend on the basket

qty.description: Number of pots, 1 to 10; more is capped at 10

name: check_promo

estimated_discount_gbp.description: Estimated saving on the subtotal in GBP; checkout confirms it

subtotal_gbp.description: Slimes subtotal before the discount in pounds sterling (GBP), e.g. 8.99

subtotal_pence.description: Slimes subtotal before the discount in pence (GBP minor units), e.g. 899

title: Check a promo code
